verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents forecasting revenue, costs, and cash 'from what drives your business'. It models the effect of a hire or a price change, offers growth and hire-wave scenarios, and lets users change assumptions in a Model built from formulas and Variables rather than static rows. All of this comes from short vendor marketing and doc snippets. missing for 10: detailed docs showing how growth, price-point, and headcount drivers are defined and linked (e.g., a driver or assumption reference), independent or hands-on corroboration.
